es: Negociar cambios de rutina respetando preferencias y necesidades.

teaching.audioText: Three actions make a small plan realistic.

teaching.en: Review the changes and keep useful habits.
teaching.es: Revisa los cambios y conserva hábitos útiles.
teaching.explanationEs: La revisión permite ajustar la rutina.
teaching.audioText: Review the changes and keep useful habits.

teaching.en: The community group enjoys cooking because shared meals give everyone energy. It avoids using screens after nine because members want to sleep better. The group wants to prepare dinner earlier, so meals stay regular, and it hopes to walk after dinner to remain active. Together, members agree to keep cooking, stop using screens after nine, and walk after dinner. They will review these three actions on Sunday and adjust only the change that proves difficult. This keeps preferences separate from intentions in a realistic plan.
teaching.es: El grupo disfruta cocinar por la energía compartida, evita pantallas por el sueño, prepara la cena antes y camina para mantenerse activo. Revisará las tres acciones el domingo.
teaching.explanationEs: Este modelo integra dos patrones -ing, dos to-infinitive, razones concretas y tres acciones acordadas.
